message.summary: one paragraph a human can read

humanGateShape.decidedBy: human name, never a bot id

rules: Teammate messages use this object. The request thread is Lead's chat.
stage-return and build-result come back to Lead. Lead appends a stage-transition record and then messages the next owner.

A bot never decides a gate. The stage owner of a gate stage may send stage-return with humanGate.status approved|rejected only when copying a human reply: decidedBy is a human name, and note is '<ISO-8601 time> | verbatim: <reply>'. Lead rejects anything else.
Every bot copies Release Desk Log (priority false) on each message sent or received, each REJECT, and each gate ask/decision; Lead also copies each stage transition. The Log never routes or approves.
build-result carries proposedBranch, prUrl, testsPassed, and testsSummary. Lead uses it for the test gate. Builder copies the release-intel result into testsSummary.
